sessions.title: ANZ Fortnightly Cadence — Corp Field, Partner Driven and Next Gen Accounts
sessions.summary:
- Leadership discussions following SAPPHIRE and APAC meetings highlighted the need to update the business plan and potentially reframe growth pillars.
- The organization is targeting 1.2B cloud revenue within four years, requiring stronger inorganic growth initiatives.
- Cross‑sell, Move, and LoB campaigns remain critical, but require better programmatic management and measurable pipeline tracking.
- Corporate segment faces renewal and churn risks due to 5‑year contract cycles and the 1.2 CDP threshold.
- Enterprise cross‑sell analysis work can be extended to Corporate to improve whitespace visibility and prioritization.
- Collaboration across Sales, SDR, Analytics, and leadership teams is essential to move the dial.
keyPoints: Post‑SAPPHIRE and APAC leadership updates Market Unit deck submitted; positive feedback received. Business plan refresh underway, including potential pillar rebranding.
Growth target reaffirmed From 499M cloud revenue to 1.2B by end of decade (4 years remaining). Need for strategic, non‑day‑to‑day initiatives to accelerate growth.

Programmatic management of Move & Cross‑sell Two‑stream model: Sales handles install‑base priorities. SDRs support outreach and qualification for expansion opportunities. Sales may reuse SDR‑created assets.
Data gaps in cross‑sell Current approach relies on team intuition. Enterprise team (Linda, Sonia) has strong whitespace analysis that can be adapted for Corporate.
Corporate renewal challenges Many 5‑year contracts approaching renewal. 1.2 CDP threshold creates structural barriers. Some deals require taking a compensation hit to prevent churn.
Need for measurable pipeline tracking Industry‑in‑a‑box, Blitz Days, and other initiatives require clear pipeline representation. Cecilia can support with data and analytics.
decisions: Business plan will be updated and growth pillars may be rebranded.
Enterprise cross‑sell analysis will be extended to Corporate.
Sonia will connect with Corporate team to share whitespace and pipeline insights.
Pipeline measurement framework will be developed for key programs.
Cecilia will support Corporate analytics needs.
